title: PWS update message
description: Current firmware version and update state, published retained on pws/{device_id}/update (QoS 1) whenever the state changes. The contract example carries no 'v' or 'device_id'; both are accepted as optional additive fields and proposed as required in schemas/README.md. Unknown keys are ignored by the server.

v.description: Payload version. Optional until the contract adds it to the update example.

device_id.description: Publishing device. Optional; the topic already carries it.

target.description: Version the device is moving to, or null when no update is pending (state idle or good).

state.description: Update state machine position. 'deferred' (for example weak LTE signal) is not a failure. 'good' means the new version booted and confirmed itself; 'rolled_back' means the bootloader returned to the previous slot.

error.description: Human readable error for state failed or rolled_back, null otherwise.

ts.description: Time of the last state change, UTC.
